# Contribution Guide

Thank you for your interest in this repository. It holds the GitHub profile page for **Evren Delacroix** (`evreniel`). Contributions are welcome for corrections, broken links, and rendering issues.

## What to Contribute

- Fix typos, grammar, or broken Markdown.
- Report links that no longer resolve.
- Suggest structural improvements that keep the page readable.

This repository does not contain application code. Feature requests for unrelated projects are out of scope.

## How to Contribute

1. Fork the repository on GitHub.
2. Clone your fork and create a descriptive branch.
3. Make your changes and commit with a clear English message.
4. Push the branch and open a pull request.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:<your-user>/evreniel.git
cd evreniel
git switch -c docs/fix-typo
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs: fix broken project link"
git push -u origin docs/fix-typo
```

## Guidelines

- Write documentation in English.
- Keep the monochrome design: black, white, and grey only. No emoji, no colored badges.
- Do not use em dashes. Use a hyphen.
- Keep the centered header block and left-aligned body sections.
- Verify every changed link before opening a pull request.

## Reporting Issues

Found a typo, a broken link, or a rendering problem? Use the [issue templates](https://github.com/evreniel/evreniel/issues/new/choose).

## Security

Vulnerabilities must never be reported through public issues. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the responsible disclosure process.

## Communication

Questions and private matters: [contact@evreniel.com](mailto:contact@evreniel.com).

Thank you for contributing.
